scripts.contract:generate: pnpm contract:export && pnpm exec openapi-typescript packages/api-contract/openapi.json -o packages/api-contract/schema.d.ts
scripts.contract:check: pnpm contract:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-contract/openapi.json packages/api-contract/schema.d.ts
scripts.check:web: pnpm lint:web && pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm test:web && pnpm build:web
scripts.check:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api db/migrations scripts/export_openapi.py && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/src apps/api/tests db/migrations/env.py && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.check: pnpm contract:check && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:api
